notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: the R2 hardware backend is refused until reviewed_by is set. The hardware path and the upstream transport were never run. The fake is an in-memory stand-in (not the upstream MockUSBDevice, which this package neither imports nor runs); it returns eight pixels of test data. NOT COVERED: the full detector array (the real length is the unit's EEPROM pixel count, wasatch/FeatureIdentificationDevice.py:1401-1403, not a constant of the class), the EEPROM wavecal coefficients and the per-unit wavelength range, laser power control, the detector TEC set-point write, area scan, GPIO/accessory outputs, auto-Raman, and the BLE/TCP/IDS/Andor transports. The spectrum action returns every pixel the upstream get_spectrum returns and the axis from settings.wavelengths; it uses the current integration time and takes no input. The integration time limit is operator_required because the minimum and maximum are per-unit EEPROM fields (wasatch/EEPROM.py:105-106); site-limits.example.json is an operator example, not a statement about a unit. No line of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop, so SAFE-045 is met by the x-cap safe-state action x-cap.wasatchphotonics.laser_off.v1, and estop_physical_ref is not set. The two x-cap ids are recorded in catalogue_requests. gate.digest is the digest line of the last gate run; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
